scripts.dev: node scripts/bootstrap.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @fire-robot/server" "npm run dev -w @fire-robot/web"
scripts.start: node scripts/bootstrap.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm start -w @fire-robot/server" "npm start -w @fire-robot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fire-robot/server && npm run build -w @fire-robot/web
